items.problem: Whole-window blank render: the scaffold's <Window.SystemBackdrop><MicaBackdrop/> cannot composite on headless/software-GPU capture hosts, so the migrated window paints blank (UIA tree populated, nothing rendered) and scores 0 despite building and launching.
items.evidence: migration-score.json (4/4 fail, 'controls exist in the UIA tree with valid geometry but nothing is painted'); parity 01_Connecting_To_Device.png 12562 bytes uniform-white vs 80979-byte UWP golden; session-log.txt 2077-2091 (scaffold Mica backdrop kept).
items.root_cause: dotnet new winui (mandated Step 0) always emits a Mica SystemBackdrop that depends on DWM composition absent in the validation/CI environment; the app stays alive so every process-alive gate passes.
items.change: Add bootstrap step 3c to Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 that strips <Window.SystemBackdrop>…</Window.SystemBackdrop> (and self-closing form) from every scaffolded/target Window .xaml so no migrated shell depends on a backdrop to paint.
items.expected_effect: Every migrated window paints its content on the default opaque background regardless of host GPU/DWM; captures are no longer byte-uniform blank.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, parity screenshots are no longer ~12.5KB uniform-white; feature #1 controls (Connect/Disconnect buttons, device list, status bar) are visible; the app scores > 0.

items.problem: The alive-check gates (Test-AppLaunch / Validator §7) cannot see a whole-window blank, so a re-introduced backdrop (e.g. from a hand-written shell conversion) would go unflagged.
items.evidence: SKILL.md line 160 + MIGRATION-PATTERNS 229-230: process-alive gate does not navigate/capture; the blank passed all of them in this trial.
items.change: Add Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 Section 9: WARN when any Window .xaml still declares a Mica/DesktopAcrylic SystemBackdrop, pointing at the remove-backdrop + opaque-root-Background fix.
items.expected_effect: A surviving backdrop is surfaced as a WARN during Step 4 validation instead of silently shipping a blank window.
items.falsifiable_check: Running the validator on a shell that still has <MicaBackdrop/> prints '[WARN] System backdrop present …'; a stripped shell prints '[PASS] No render-blocking system backdrop'.

items.problem: No documentation distinguishing the whole-window backdrop blank from the per-page navigation/init blank, so an agent that hand-writes or regenerates the Window shell has no guidance to avoid re-adding the backdrop.
items.evidence: grep of the skill: 'Backdrop' appeared only as an AcrylicBrush mapping row; all blank-render prose was per-page.
items.change: Add MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#system-backdrop-blank-window (symptom/root-cause/fix) and a SKILL.md 'Defensive UI' callout distinguishing the two blank modes and pointing to it.
items.expected_effect: An agent doing a shell conversion knows not to rely on a system backdrop and to give the root layout an opaque Background.
items.falsifiable_check: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor system-backdrop-blank-window returns the new section; SKILL.md links to it from the Defensive-UI section.
